flashcard_questions.q: Where is India located within Asia?
flashcard_questions.a: In South Asia, in the Northern Hemisphere.

flashcard_questions.q: How many countries share a land border with India?
What is a Newly Emerging Economy?
flashcard_questions.a: A country experiencing high rates of economic development, usually with rapid industrialisation.

flashcard_questions.q: When did India formally gain independence from Britain?
What was the partition of India?
flashcard_questions.a: The division of British India in 1947 into three separate countries.

flashcard_questions.q: Which disputed region still causes military conflict between India and Pakistan?
When did India become a fully democratic state?
When did India overtake China as the world's most populous country?
By when is India projected to become the world's second-largest economy?
How many people of Indian origin live outside India?
How much does India receive in remittances each year?
Which desert lies in the north-west of India?
Why did India's death rate fall as the country developed?
flashcard_questions.a: Medical facilities and access to healthcare improved.

notes: 15 cards: 3 term-to-definition (NEE, partition, location), 10 case-study-to-fact naming India with one figure or date each (six borders, 1947, 1950, 1.4 billion, 2023, 2050, 34.5 million, $125 billion, 400 million, Kashmir), 1 place-to-feature (Thar Desert), 1 cause-to-consequence (falling death rate). The 3 million km² area, the five-year election cycle, Bollywood and the Mumbai and New Delhi rainfall figures were trimmed to stay within 15. Religious diversity was left out because any card on it would ask for a list.
